params.name: type
params.description: Filter by asset type (image, notimage, document, other)

params.name: main_image
params.description: To display only main images, set this to true

params.name: created_from
params.description: Filters assets by the created date, starting from the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date

params.name: created_to
params.description: Filters assets by the created date, up to the specified date. Use the format yyyy-mm-dd to input the date.

params.name: model
params.description: Filter by attachment type (Property, Unit, Tenancy, Transaction)

params.name: page
params.description: Page number, between 1 and the total number of pages.

params.name: sort
params.description: Field to sort the collection by.
